title: Hospital stocks slip after SC query on steep cancer drug markups
summary: In a landmark ruling, the Supreme Court of India highlighted troubling markups on cancer drugs enforced by hospitals, urging a probe into reports of patients being directed to specific pharmacies for their medications. Following this announcement, the BSE Hospitals Index faced a steep 5% drop, leading to notable losses for industry giants like Apollo Hospitals and Fortis Healthcare.

title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
summary: Benchmark indices faced a decline as global uncertainty impacted the market and investor sentiment remained cautious. The Nifty index is under pressure, with 22,600 acting as a significant support level. Foreign portfolio investors recorded a net sale of shares worth Rs 10,148 crore while domestic institutions were net buyers. The rupee settled flat against the US dollar amidst heavy FII outflows.

summary: Indian equity benchmarks experienced a decline over two sessions due to profit booking and rising oil prices. The Nifty 50 index closed down by 95.75 points, reaching 22,620.45. Infosys has expanded its partnership with ABN AMRO for AI-driven transformation initiatives.

title: Can October turn the tide for Indian stocks after September rout?
summary: As investors approach October, the landscape is shaped by high crude oil prices, increasing bond yields, and continued foreign selling. Historically, October has favored positive market returns, yet recent downturns could challenge this pattern. With the earnings season on the horizon, corporate profitability, particularly within large-cap stocks, will be under scrutiny.

title: Sebi, RBI join hands to make onboarding easier for FPIs
summary: In a proactive move, the Securities and Exchange Board of India has teamed up with the Reserve Bank of India to enhance various regulatory procedures. Their primary focus is on making it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. The launch of the India Market Access portal in September 2025 marked a significant step forward in this initiative.

title: Stock Radar: Varun Beverages stock showing signs of rebound after over 20% fall; time to buy?
summary: Varun Beverages Ltd has shown a strong technical recovery after breaking out of a three-month downtrend channel. The stock regained crucial moving averages, which suggests a potential upward trend for traders.

title: Claude, New Yorker, Bandcamp: RBI rules leave international card payments in grey area
summary: New regulations from the Reserve Bank of India will mandate reporting of international credit card transactions starting October 1. Consumers may need to provide details on all payments for services purchased abroad, leading to potential compliance challenges. The existing framework lacks clarity on how individuals will report these transactions to banks. While international credit card purchases are part of the Liberalised Remittance Scheme, the reporting process remains unclear.

title: Rating upgrades moderate in H1 as India Inc faces multiple headwinds
summary: Rating upgrades moderated in the first half of the financial year as companies faced headwinds from the West Asia conflict, rising crude prices, higher input costs and evolving US tariff measures. Downgrades also declined, though rating agencies cautioned that this may not capture cases where issuers do not cooperate with adverse reviews.

title: Personal loan growth rises to 16.9% in August: RBI
summary: Bank credit growth strengthened across major sectors in August, with personal loans rising 16.9% year-on-year to ₹72.9 lakh crore, up from 11.9% a year earlier, RBI data showed.

title: Bank deposit rates fall as fresh lending rates rise in August
summary: In August, banks lowered the weighted average rate on fresh rupee term deposits to 5.67%. At the same time, the average lending rate on new loans increased to 8.61%. Public sector banks experienced a decrease in deposit rates, while private banks faced a similar trend. Lending rates varied based on loan types, with personal loans seeing a significant increase.

title: HDFC Bank names ICICI veteran banker V.N. Srivatsan as Chief Compliance Officer
summary: HDFC Bank has appointed V.N. Srivatsan as its Chief Compliance Officer for a three-year term, effective from his joining date on January 4, 2027. Srivatsan, currently Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank, has around 34 years of professional experience, including 25 years in BFSI.

title: Bigger loans lift digital lenders’ books 28% as outstanding accounts decline
summary: Digital lenders in India experienced a notable 28% increase in their personal-loan portfolios over the past year. The number of outstanding loan accounts slightly decreased to 5.64 crore, indicating a shift towards larger balances. New loan sanctions also surged by 50%, highlighting a strong demand for personal loans. Borrowers with limited credit histories and younger customers contributed significantly to this growth.

summary: A new wave of mid-tier consulting firms, founded by former Big Four partners, is targeting startups, private equity and venture capital clients with specialized services. They offer equity, independence and flat structures to lure senior talent.

title: Noel and son move to shield Trusts as Tata Sons tussle heats up
summary: Noel Tata and son Neville have filed a bunch of caveats with the charitable trusts regulator against Venu Srinivasan’s complaints over Tata Trusts, seeking to guard against adverse orders that could constrain the Trusts in the ongoing tussle at Tata Sons ahead of a key shareholder meet.

title: Dilip Buildcon aims to double coal output by FY29 in major mining push
summary: The firm aims to achieve 57 million tonnes of coal output by FY29 and expand into bauxite, shifting 75% of profits from traditional EPC to long-term mining assets, MD &amp; CEO Devendra Jain told Mint.
